title: Cached TURN credentials retain their original advertised TTL
test: tests/turnCredentialCache.test.js: 'cached TURN credentials advertise the remaining lifetime'
proof: On the unchanged code the test failed at its second request, which came about 10.5 s after the first mint and was served from the cache: 'cached ttlSeconds 120 should be below the original 120'. The fake Cloudflare endpoint saw one mint, so the cache was used, and the replayed ttlSeconds was the full 120. After the fix the cache hit advertises floor((mintedAt + ttl*1000 - now) / 1000), here 109, and the test passes; the cache window (ttl - 60 s) and the rate limit are unchanged.
